001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * One slot of the pump's 64-bit software ID. The high word is the firmware version word also
009 * found in {@link VersionsAHistoryLog#getArmSwVersion()}, {@link ArmInitHistoryLog#getVersion()}
010 * and {@code PumpVersionResponse.armSwVer}. Printed as {@code %08x%08x} (high word first), the
011 * two words are the 16-digit hex string the pump returns in {@code CommonSoftwareInfoResponse}.
012 * That was checked on four Tandem Mobi firmware versions, 7.6.0.3 to 7.9.0.2. Both words
013 * change together at a firmware update and are the same on every pump running that firmware, so
014 * they identify the software, not the device.
015 *
016 * <p>Written in the block that follows every NewDay (right after {@link VersionsAHistoryLog}, one
017 * record per slot), including the NewDay written after a time or date change. Also written at
018 * boot, one record per slot as that slot's value becomes available. A boot that crosses midnight
019 * first logs the NewDay block before the slots are filled, so those records have both words 0
020 * (see {@link #isSoftwareIdKnown()}). Seen in 288 records from two t:slim X2 and five Mobi pumps.
021 * t:slim X2 firmware older than the late-2023 update does not write it.
022 *
023 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 449 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
024 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
025 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.
026 */
027@HistoryLogProps(
028    opCode = 449,
029    displayName = "Software ID"
030)
031public class SoftwareIdHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
032
033    private int slot;
034    private int unknown11;
035    private long armSwVersion;
036    private long softwareIdLow;
037    private long unknown22;
038
039    public SoftwareIdHistoryLog() {}
040    public SoftwareIdHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int slot, int unknown11, long armSwVersion, long softwareIdLow, long unknown22) {
041        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
042        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, slot, unknown11, armSwVersion, softwareIdLow, unknown22);
043        this.slot = slot;
044        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
045        this.armSwVersion = armSwVersion;
046        this.softwareIdLow = softwareIdLow;
047        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
048    }
049
050    public SoftwareIdHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int slot, long armSwVersion, long softwareIdLow) {
051        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, slot, 0, armSwVersion, softwareIdLow, 0);
052    }
053
054    public int typeId() {
055        return 449;
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * <table border="1">
060     * <caption>Parsed fields for SoftwareIdHistoryLog:</caption>
061     * <tr><td><code>slot</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>(raw[11] &amp; 0xFF) | ((raw[12] &amp; 0xFF) &lt;&lt; 8) | ((raw[13] &amp; 0xFF) &lt;&lt; 16)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>armSwVersion</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>softwareIdLow</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
066     * </table>
067     */
068    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
069        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
070        this.cargo = raw;
071        parseBase(raw);
072        this.slot = raw[10] & 0xFF;
073        this.unknown11 = (raw[11] & 0xFF) | ((raw[12] & 0xFF) << 8) | ((raw[13] & 0xFF) << 16);
074        this.armSwVersion = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
075        this.softwareIdLow = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
076        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
077    }
078
079    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int slot, int unknown11, long armSwVersion, long softwareIdLow, long unknown22) {
080        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
081            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(449, 0),
082            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
083            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
084            new byte[]{
085                (byte) slot,
086                (byte) (unknown11 & 0xFF),
087                (byte) ((unknown11 >> 8) & 0xFF),
088                (byte) ((unknown11 >> 16) & 0xFF)
089            },
090            Bytes.toUint32(armSwVersion),
091            Bytes.toUint32(softwareIdLow),
092            Bytes.toUint32(unknown22)));
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * Raw slot index. Seen values are 0-3 on the Tandem Mobi and 0 and 2 on the t:slim X2. The
097     * daily block writes them in the order 0, 2, 1, 3 (Mobi) or 0, 2 (X2). At a Mobi boot, slots 0
098     * and 1 are written first and slots 2 and 3 about 2-3 seconds later, together with opcode 450.
099     * Every filled slot has carried the same ID so far, so what each slot stands for is unknown.
100     *
101     * @return raw uint8 at offset 10
102     */
103    public int getSlot() {
104        return slot;
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * Always 0 so far. May be the high bytes of a 32-bit slot index.
109     *
110     * @return raw uint24 (little endian) at offsets 11-13
111     */
112    public int getUnknown11() {
113        return unknown11;
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * High word of the software ID. Equal to {@link VersionsAHistoryLog#getArmSwVersion()} of the
118     * same pump and firmware. 0 in a slot that has not been filled yet.
119     *
120     * @return uint32 at offset 14
121     */
122    public long getArmSwVersion() {
123        return armSwVersion;
124    }
125
126    /**
127     * Low word of the software ID. One value per firmware version. Not
128     * {@link VersionInfoHistoryLog#getArmCrc()} and not a part number. What it is derived from is
129     * unknown. 0 in a slot that has not been filled yet.
130     *
131     * @return uint32 at offset 18
132     */
133    public long getSoftwareIdLow() {
134        return softwareIdLow;
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Always 0 so far.
139     *
140     * @return raw uint32 at offset 22
141     */
142    public long getUnknown22() {
143        return unknown22;
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * @return false if both ID words are 0, meaning this slot was logged before its value was known
148     */
149    public boolean isSoftwareIdKnown() {
150        return armSwVersion != 0 || softwareIdLow != 0;
151    }
152
153    /**
154     * @return the software ID as 16 lowercase hex digits, high word first, as in
155     *         {@code CommonSoftwareInfoResponse}; an empty string if {@link #isSoftwareIdKnown()} is false
156     */
157    public String getSoftwareId() {
158        if (!isSoftwareIdKnown()) {
159            return "";
160        }
161        return String.format("%08x%08x", armSwVersion, softwareIdLow);
162    }
163}
